registered: 2026-11-06, after agents_m1_m3_v1 (sealed); NOT run: needs Joel's explicit authorization and call budget
purpose: same M2/M3 cases with the v2 single-shot prompts and the validate_route objective-id fix, to test whether the defects found in v1 were the interface's or the model's; dev split only

dataset.why: development split: the new single-shot agent prompts may be iterated afterwards without touching the frozen eval_v3/adversarial_v3

budget.rule: no extra call to improve a result; another call is a new registered experiment

selection_rules.M1: first dev_v3 case expected PROPOSED_PENDING_AUTHORIZATION (simple valid); first case of category ambiguous; first case expected REFUSED_UNSAFE
selection_rules.M2: among dev_v3 cases where the drone agent is invoked under gold delegation (D01 D05 D09 D10 D11 D13): first expected PROPOSED with only aerial objectives (simple valid); first sensor_incompatible (request not satisfiable as stated); first swarm case not expected PROPOSED (coordination conflict)
selection_rules.M3: dev_v3 cases where the rover agent is invoked (D11 D12 D14): rover waits for a drone (valid); no drone reaches the wait point (dependency incomplete); rover declared in maintenance (availability constraint)

experiments.what_the_llm_decides: which eligible drone takes which aerial objective and in which order, and which verification tools to run; gate = evaluate_proposal + deconfliction; a rejected proposal falls back to the deterministic reference (recorded, never counted as an agent success)
the ground tasks (declared target, wait point) or what is missing, and which verification tools to run; the deterministic rover agent keeps the last word (advisory gate)

oracle_note: M2/M3 delegate with the case's hand-written gold brief (mode oracle, a labelled reference, never a model) so that the specialist is tested on the task it is meant to receive; M0 uses the same delegation
preconditions: no Gazebo/SITL/ArduPilot/MAVProxy/ROS 2/XRCE process on the host or in the tfg-ardupilot-gazebo container
